A request submitted later than the delivery lead time before the need date does not guarantee the material arrives on time - resulting downtime is charged to the requester, not the Procurement Dept.

blocks.text: A separate timesheet for EACH piece of equipment. Filled in daily by the driver / operator. Submitted to PTD every Friday by 18:00, signed by the site manager.

Day code: W - worked · D - downtime (reason mandatory!) · R - repair · O - day off / not on site.

Engine hours and fuel are not written off without the timesheet. Consumption above the norm without explanation - review with the mechanic, possible deduction.

name: Tender Offers Comparison Table
purpose: Min. 3 quotes: price / lead time / warranty / selection + justification
sanction: A purchase without 3 quotes or a selection without justification - the contract is not signed.

blocks.text: В7. Tender Offers Comparison Table - Instructions
Any purchase of works, materials, or services requires a minimum of 3 commercial quotes. This table is a mandatory attachment to the contractor or supplier selection.

items: Quotes are collected by the Project Manager together with PTD; the tender is organized by the Client's Service.
All participants receive the same terms of reference and the same conditions - otherwise the comparison is meaningless.
Fill in the table for each criterion. Prices should be on a single basis (VAT-inclusive or exclusive - the same for everyone).
The cheapest does not always win: lead time, warranty, experience, and payment terms also matter.
If the selection is NOT the lowest price - justification in the block below is mandatory.
Approval: PM/PTD prepared → Head of Client's Service approved → CEO confirmed. Next - the contract (legal review 3 business days).
A purchase without 3 quotes or a selection without justification - the contract is not signed, payment is not made.

Rule: first a registered change, then the work. Work without a change is unauthorized and unpaid.
Initiator - anyone: site foreman, site manager, PTD, PM, Technical Supervision. The foreman records the issue → the site manager initiates the change.

Approval route: initiator → PTD (scope and cost estimate check) → Project Manager → Head of Client's Service. A change outside the approved cost estimate is approved only by the CEO.
Response time - 5 business days. The change is logged in the change register (maintained by PTD); the schedule and cost estimate are updated at the same time.
Work performed without a registered change is considered unauthorized and is not paid. The costs are borne by the contractor.

blocks.text: Г4. Work Stoppage / Resumption Certificate - instructions
The right to stop works belongs to: Technical Supervision, the HSE Engineer, and the Head of Client's Service - when quality or safety is at risk, or there is a significant deviation from the design.

items: The initiator draws up the certificate: basis, scope of the stopped works, correction requirements, and deadline.
The certificate is handed over the same day to the PM, the Site Manager, and the Head of Client's Service; the Head of Client's Service notifies the CEO.
Works within the specified scope stop immediately upon delivery of the certificate.
The contractor corrects the violation and notifies in writing that it is ready for inspection.
The initiator verifies the correction; resumption is allowed only with the initiator's written permission, approved by the Head of Client's Service (bottom section of the certificate).
Downtime caused by the contractor is not compensated; losses are recorded in the claims register (claim - Г8).

Masonry of the 3rd-floor exterior walls is being performed from scaffolding without guardrails and without fall-protection equipment - a direct threat to life (violation of NPAOP 45.2-7.02).
2. Scope of stopped works (works, zones, axes)

blocks.text: Е1. PTD–CONSTRUCTION SITE UNIT INTERACTION PROCEDURE
The monthly planning-and-closeout cycle in detail: who submits what and when, what exactly PTD checks, and what happens on deviations. Version 1.0. Approved by the CEO. Changes only through Г1.

rows: This procedure sets out how PTD (the Production & Technical Dept) and a construction site unit interact throughout the entire monthly cycle: issuing documentation → planning → weekly rhythm → month-end closeout → technical verification note.
Mandatory for: the Head of PTD, the cost engineer, the Site Manager, the Site Foreman, the Project Manager. Technical Supervision and the lab technician are involved in confirming works and quality.
Core principle: PTD is the single point of documentation issuance and the single filter before money moves. The Site builds - PTD counts and reconciles. Neither side substitutes for the other.
The Site's package for the next month: work plan (Б1) + schedule (Б2) + material needs (В1). Submitted by the 25th.
The month-end closeout package (Б3): act + timesheets + as-built documentation + delivery notes and certificates. Submitted by the 5th.
PTD's living document (Г5): amount budgeted per the cost estimate / amount completed cumulatively / balance remaining for each work item and material. The main safeguard against double closeouts.

Anything beyond what is allowed: volume beyond the cost estimate or remaining balance; write-off beyond the norm plus tolerance (Е9); work outside the plan without Г1; re-closing something already closed. An overrun is not accepted (section 4.6).
PTD's final monthly conclusion (form set out in regulation Е3). Without it, payment for the month is not confirmed.

header: What they do in the cycle
rows: Submits the plan by the 25th, weekly timesheets and delivery notes, the reporting package by the 5th; explains deviations
Timeliness and completeness of submissions; accuracy of volumes in the act
Keeps the works log, dockets, daily timesheets; prepares data for the act
Issues documentation, checks the plan and package, maintains the cumulative register, prepares the verification note
Review timelines; a missed overrun is PTD's responsibility
Reconciles prices and volumes against the cost estimate; write-off norms (Е9); deviation report
Monitors timelines on both sides; resolves first-level disputes
Keeping the cycle moving without breakdowns
Confirms volumes and quality by signature on the act and the CWAC

ISSUING DOCUMENTATION. Design documentation reaches the Site ONLY through PTD, stamped "For execution" and logged in the issuance log (see the "Issuance Log" tab). Turnaround on request - 1 business day. The Site works only with the current version; using an outdated version is the fault of whoever took it. Drawings obtained bypassing PTD are not a valid document.

PLANNING (by the 25th). The Site Manager submits the monthly plan: Б1 + Б2 + В1. PTD checks it against the checklist (see the "PTD Review Checklist" tab, Block A): 1) work names match the cost estimate exactly; 2) volumes are within the Cumulative Works Register's remaining balances; 3) works match the design and approved changes (Г1); 4) the schedule is technologically realistic: work sequences and links to other works; 5) material needs match volumes per the Е9 norms; 6) delivery lead times allow ordering on time. Review deadline - by the 28th.

PLAN REVIEW OUTCOME: "Approved" - PTD forwards the material needs to Procurement and the plan goes to the Head of CS for funding approval; "Returned" - a written list of comments to the Site Manager, correction within 1 business day, re-review within 1 day. A month without an approved plan is not funded.

WEEKLY RHYTHM (every Friday by 18:00). The Site submits to PTD: weekly machinery timesheets (В5, signed) + delivery notes and certificates for the week's deliveries. PTD on Monday: registers the documents, reconciles deliveries against В1 requests, and enters them in the Cumulative Works Register. A delivery/request mismatch triggers a query to the Site Manager, response within 1 business day.

MONTH-END CLOSEOUT (by the 5th). The Site submits the Б3 reporting package. PTD checks it against the checklist (Block B): 1) the act's arithmetic (volumes, totals); 2) names and units match the cost estimate; 3) actual work versus the monthly plan - deviations explained; 4) the cumulative register: nothing already closed is being re-closed and the remaining balance is not exceeded; 5) signatures of the Site Manager and Technical Supervision on every act; 6) CWAC: one for every concealed work of the month, with photos, certificates, and protocols (Г7); 7) machinery timesheets against the acts: any machinery "that worked" appears in the works; 8) material write-offs (M-29) against Е9 norms plus tolerance. Review deadline - by the 10th.

OVERRUNS AND DEVIATIONS. A detected overrun is NOT accepted: the line item is excluded from confirmation, and the Site Manager receives a written request for an explanation (deadline - 2 business days). Next: if it is a genuine, legitimate change in volumes - a Г1 is filed and the line item is accepted the following month; if there is no explanation or it is not confirmed - the line item is not paid, it is recorded in a memo (Г9), and if the contractor is at fault, a claim (Г8) follows.

TECHNICAL VERIFICATION NOTE (by the 10th). Based on the review, PTD prepares a technical verification note (form Е3, "Technical Verification Note" tabs): sections for works / materials / machinery / completeness / conclusion. Conclusions: "confirmed" - the acts go to the Head of CS; "partial" - the confirmed part goes to payment, disputed line items go to rework with deadlines; "returned" - the whole package is returned (correction within 2 business days, re-review within 2 days).

SITE REQUESTS TO PTD (outside the cycle): write-off norms and coefficients - answer within 1 business day; issuance/clarification of documentation - 1 day; cost estimate consultation (via the cost engineer) - 2 days. All requests go through Worksection.

blocks.text: The single procedure for initiating, reviewing, approving, and executing payments. Version 1.0. Approved by the General Director. Changes only through a change request (Г1).

rows: This procedure sets out the single, mandatory path every technical-block payment must follow: from initiation to execution by the finance block.

It applies to all project payments: to contractors for works, to suppliers for materials, for external-machinery rental and services, for casual labor. Mandatory for all participants in the process, without exception.
Purpose: not a single hryvnia moves without documented proof of completion; PTD is the filter that catches overruns and unconfirmed works BEFORE the money leaves.
The person who enters a payment into the payment register: the Project Manager; the Site Manager - via the PM.
A living register (maintained by the finance block): every payment has a filled-in "contract" column, initiator, amount, basis, and status.
The set of documents proving the basis for a payment (composition - section 4.2). Missing even one document makes the package incomplete.
PTD's monthly reconciliation (works/materials/machinery against the plan, cost estimate, and norms) - the filter for the month's payments (regulation Е1).

Approval threshold amounts: up to the limit (the amount is set by the CEO) - the Head of CS; above the limit (the amount is set by the CEO) - the CEO (see the "Authority Matrix" section of the Regulations).
Enters the payment in the register, assembles the complete package, submits it to PTD
Completeness and accuracy of the package; the link to the contract
Reconciles the package against the cost estimate and the Cumulative Works Register; prepares the technical verification note
Preventing overruns and double closeouts; review deadline
Confirms that prices and volumes match the cost estimate; keeps the deviation report
Confirms, by signature on the acts, the fact and quality of the work performed
Approves payments within the limit; sets the weekly payment priority
Approves payments above the limit, outside the cost estimate, advances beyond the norm
Executes payment per the register after all sign-offs; maintains statuses
3-business-day payment deadline; payments only per the register

PRECONDITIONS. A payment is possible only if: (a) the contract has passed legal review, is signed, and is entered in the contract register; (b) the cost estimate for the works is approved; (c) the works have been accepted by Technical Supervision / the materials were delivered with quality documents. If even one precondition is missing, initiation is not possible.

COMPLETE-PACKAGE COMPOSITION by payment type. CONTRACTOR WORKS: the KB-2v act + the KB-3 statement, signed by the Site Manager and Technical Supervision; closed CWACs for the works in the act; if the contractor supplied materials - delivery notes and certificates. MATERIALS: delivery note, invoice, quality certificates/passports, match to the В1 request. EXTERNAL MACHINERY / CASUAL LABOR: contract, dockets or waybills signed by the Site Foreman on the day of work (В3 request). SERVICES: contract, service acceptance act, invoice.

INITIATION. The Initiator enters the payment in the payment register (contract, amount, basis, link to the package) and submits the package to PTD. A payment outside the register does not exist and is not considered.

PTD REVIEW - 2 business days: reconciling volumes and prices against the cost estimate; reconciling against the Cumulative Works Register (protection from double closeout); checking the package's completeness and signatures. Outcome: PTD's sign-off in the register, or a return to the Initiator stating the reason. A returned package, once corrected, is resubmitted - the review clock restarts.

MONTHLY FILTER. Acts for the reporting month are approved only after PTD's technical verification note (by the 10th, regulation Е1). Without the note, payment for the month is not confirmed - no exceptions.

LIMIT-BASED APPROVAL - 2 business days: within the cost estimate, up to the limit - the Head of CS; above the limit - the CEO; ANY payment outside the approved cost estimate - the CEO only, and only on an approved change request (Г1); an advance beyond the norm (the percentage is set by the CEO) - the CEO only.

PAYMENT. The finance block executes the payment within 3 business days of a complete package of sign-offs. In case of a funds shortage, the Head of CS sets the weekly priority order; critical discrepancies go to the CEO. The register status is updated on the day of payment.

STOP CONDITIONS: a payment is NOT executed if: there is no contract in the register; there is no Technical Supervision signature on the act; there is no technical verification note for the month; the works were performed in a suspended zone (an active Г4 act applies); the works were performed without a change request (unauthorized); there is an active claim with a hold (Г8) against the counterparty - for the held amount.

THE "WHERE IS MY PAYMENT" QUESTION. Payment status is queried through the Head of CS; response within 2 business days (see the "Request Routes" section of the Regulations). A contractor asks only through the PM.
